signs.aries: You get on in the world by going first, are drawn to work where something has to be started, and make your name young.
signs.taurus: You build a career slowly and hold the ground you take, and you are known for being someone who does not move under pressure.
signs.gemini: Your working life has several chapters and possibly several careers, and you are known for what you say and how you say it.
signs.cancer: You are known for looking after people, your career and your home life pull at each other, and reputation feels personal to you.
signs.leo: You want work that has your name on it, are comfortable being the visible one, and your standing matters to you more than you admit.
signs.virgo: You are known for doing it properly, get on through competence rather than self-promotion, and are the one others rely on.
signs.libra: Your career runs on relationships and on being well liked, and you are drawn to work involving fairness, mediation or design.
signs.scorpio: You accumulate quiet influence rather than visible position, are drawn to work with real stakes, and your career has been rebuilt at least once.
signs.sagittarius: Your career takes you elsewhere, literally or intellectually, and you are known for candour and for a wider view than the job requires.
signs.capricorn: This is your home ground: ambition is structural for you, authority comes with time, and you are taken seriously by middle age.
signs.aquarius: You get on by doing it differently, are drawn to work with a cause behind it, and are uncomfortable inside a conventional hierarchy.
signs.pisces: Your vocation is felt rather than chosen, your public direction stays unclear for a long time, and the work that finally fits is caring or creative.
